lede: The gondola's future takes center stage Monday when the Gondola Leadership Committee meets to work through project history, CIG funding commitments, and what sounds like real action items — not just updates. Wednesday, Parks and Recreation revisits the controversial Town Park paving project to add basketball and pickleball courts, a plan that's drawn more than 400 signatures in opposition and still has a lot of neighbors fired up. The county planning commission and Board of County Commissioners also hold a joint work session Wednesday, though no agenda has been posted yet.

notable.stake: Gondola project funding and history up for action, not just discussion.
Controversial Town Park paving project reviewed; 400+ signatures oppose it.
